description: This file contains client-side scripts for the 'Delivery Note' doctype in ERPNext, including setup functions, UI interactions, and class definitions for delivery note operations.

classes.name: DeliveryNoteController
classes.description: Controller class extending SellingController for Delivery Note operations, including setup, refresh, and status updates.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initial setup for delivery note form, including query setups and UI properties.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the form, adds buttons based on document status, and manages UI elements.

methods.name: make_shipment
methods.description: Opens the shipment creation form mapped from the current delivery note.

methods.name: make_sales_invoice
methods.description: Creates a sales invoice from the delivery note.

methods.name: make_installation_note
methods.description: Creates an installation note from the delivery note.

methods.name: make_sales_return
methods.description: Creates a sales return from the delivery note.

methods.name: make_delivery_trip
methods.description: Creates a delivery trip from the delivery note.

methods.name: items_on_form_rendered
methods.description: Sets up serial or batch numbers when delivery note items are rendered.

methods.name: packed_items_on_form_rendered
methods.description: Sets up serial or batch numbers for packed items.

methods.name: close_delivery_note
methods.description: Updates the delivery note status to 'Closed'.

methods.name: reopen_delivery_note
methods.description: Reopens a closed delivery note by updating status to 'Submitted'.

methods.name: update_status
methods.description: Updates the delivery note status via server call.
